name: AltspaceVR
summary:
AltspaceVR: a social VR app connecting people from all walks of life.

Jump right in and make yourself at home. Customize your avatar, find your style, and show up in whatever feels like YOU.

Browse an ever-expanding library of user-created spaces, visit one of our preset event locations, or even make your own! Drop into games, community meetups, performances, and live events or just come warm up by the digital campfire.

We provide the tools to help bring your most vivid virtual imaginations to life.
